welcome_sub: Log in or create an account to keep your progress on every device
oauth_not_configured: This sign-in option will work after the app is registered with the provider (stage 9.4). For now use email or continue without an account.
account_why: An account is only needed to move your data between devices. Everything works without it too.
email_invalid: Check your email and password (8+ characters)
check_email: We sent you a confirmation email. Confirm it and log in.
server_unavailable: Akii server is unavailable. You can continue without an account.
library_sub: Pick a practice — set time and sound before you start
player_hint: Choose length, voice and sound, then press ▶
mood_before_q: How do you feel right now?
mood_after_q: And how do you feel now?
sound_missing: File {} not found — add it to assets/audio
guide_1: Settle in and close your eyes
guide_2: Breathe in as the circle grows, out as it shrinks
guide_3: If thoughts wander, gently return to the breath
guide_4: Let your shoulders and jaw relax
journal_empty: No entries yet. Tap “+” to write about your day.
entry_text_hint: Write a few lines about today…
prompt_2: What can you praise yourself for?
prompt_3: What was hard and how did you cope?
prompt_4: Who are you grateful to today?
prompt_5: What would you like to do for yourself tomorrow?
entry_empty: Write at least a few words
st_calm_hint: All steady. A few minutes of practice will keep it that way.
st_glowing_hint: A whole week of practice — your Avatar is glowing!

st_tired_hint: You are tired. Try a sleep story or a calm evening.
stress_none: You have not taken the test yet.
no_badges: Your first badge comes after the first session.
plus_reports_sub: Monthly report and journal export — in Akii Plus
sq1: How would you rate your stress level?
sq2: How did you sleep last night?

stress_moderate_advice: Some tension. Ten calm minutes in the evening will help.
stress_low_advice: You are balanced. Keep it with a short focus practice.
mood_sub: Mark how you feel right now
dreams_sub: Record your dream right after waking up or describe it with tags
rec_phone_only: Voice recording works on the phone. On a computer, add tags.
plus_f6: Outfits and worlds for your Avatar
plus_footer: Payment via RuStore or App Store · SOS and journal are free
plus_test_mode: Test mode on a computer: the subscription turns on without payment.
plus_thanks: Akii Plus is on. Thank you!
store_not_ready: Store payments are connected at stage 9.3
reminder_text: Every day at the chosen time
reminder_note: On a computer the reminder appears while the app is open.
no_account: Not signed in. Your data stays on this device.
